title: Braydo's Biomes
description: Adds custom biome that I have come up with.
body:
My mod, Braydo's Biomes, is a vanilla-friendly world generation mod that adds custom biomes to Minecraft.

Rather than overwhelming the game with blocks and mechanics, my mod focuses on creating environments with distinct atmospheres and custom vegetation.

(Featured Biomes)

*Wispbloom Hollow*

A lush and enchanting forest filled with custom trees, flowering vegetation, glowing flora, and natural sniffer spawns.

*Duskwal Forest*

A semi-realistic woodland inspired by walnut forests and evergreen trees. (my personal favorite so far)

More biomes will be added in the future.

(Features)

Custom biomes designed in a vanilla style,
Custom trees and vegetation,
Natural-looking world generation, and
New building environments
